The show’s biggest stumbling block is the introduction of a socially awkward American Airbnb guest (Donna Lynne Champlin), who blunders into the domestic drama with a fruequency and duration that defies common sense.

cn.t: Critics find this Irish farmhouse drama engaging and well-acted, particularly praising Maryann Plunkett's grounded performance, though the focus on an offstage philandering man divides opinion in an otherwise compelling women's ensemble piece.
